title: Institutional XRP relationship evidence and feature-admission controls
decisions: Treat 06:42 XRPL escrow observation as tracker-reported, not raw Destination-verified.
Treat XRP phase-one inclusion as announced, BTC reopening as Reuters-reported, XRP-specific success as unverified.
Keep TradRadar seven-venue OI and Seandra Binance-only OI separate; prohibit averaging.
Keep new source IDs pending archive append and excluded from model features.
Do not merge PR #1449 or any PR; main remains unremediated until explicit approval.
Coinbase XRP/cbXRP-Morpho path is eligibility evidence only; utilization unknown.
Coinbase is multi-issuer; no exclusive Circle/Ripple alignment.
Circle Arc competes/complements XRPL; Circle also issues native USDC on XRPL.
SBI Group is multi-rail; Tokyo SBIC is separate.
Tokyo SBIC ChatGPT seminar was educational, not OpenAI partnership.
Do not admit Binance XRP status, CoinGecko OI/depth, escrow disposition or creator claims as predictive features without timestamps/corroboration.
rationale: The latest observations improve event coverage but retain transaction-disposition and source-scope gaps. Treating announcements as successful XRP withdrawals or mixing OI universes would create measurement error.
rejected_alternatives: Assume all phase-one assets available at 06:00 UTC.
Use BTC reopening as proof of XRP withdrawal success.
Average multi-venue OI with Binance-only OI.
Treat escrow release as immediate sell pressure.
